description: A `{from: <path>, as: json}` reference whose resolved value is a dict with a NaN (or infinite) float key fails to serialize, the same as one used as a value -- `json.dumps(..., allow_nan=False)` rejects a non-finite key too. The Python runner checks it on CPython 3.10 and 3.11 only: from 3.12 on, CPython appends the offending value to the message (`...: nan`).
